name: Piccolo on-screen keyboard
author: Jorge Cohen
description: Touch/on-screen keyboard for the Omarchy shell (Hyprland). Glide (swipe) typing with a finger trail, suggestion strip and terminal-aware autocorrect; 22 layouts across 9 languages with iOS-style globe switching, long-press accents, split mode and key-preview bubbles; real Ctrl/Alt/Super chords via ydotool; shares its key surface with the lock screen.
